entities.name: Additional update type
entities.description: Provides additional information about the type of request for an attach or a tracking area updating procedure. It is a type 1 information element.

entities.name: Additional update type IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier for Additional update type, located in bits 8-5 of octet 1.

entities.name: PNB-CIoT
entities.description: Preferred Network Behaviour for CIoT, located in bit 4 of octet 1.

entities.name: SAF
entities.description: Signalling Active Flag, located in bits 3-2 of octet 1.

entities.name: AUTV
entities.description: Additional Update Type Value, located in bit 1 of octet 1.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE registration with the network.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure for updating UE location within the tracking area.

relations.description: The Additional update type IE contains the IEI field.
The Additional update type IE contains the PNB-CIoT field.
The Additional update type IE contains the SAF field.
The Additional update type IE contains the AUTV field.
The Attach procedure may include the Additional update type IE to provide additional request information.
The Tracking area updating procedure may include the Additional update type IE to provide additional request information.
